short: Write down what you remember from last week's lessons without looking, then check your notes.
proof: What you wrote, checked against your notes.

title: Do One Practice Exercise for Your Skill
short: Do one short exercise for the skill you are learning.
proof: What you made.

title: Clean Your Room for 15 Minutes
short: Clean the messiest part of your room for 15 minutes.
proof: Before and after of the part you cleaned.

title: Clean Your Whole Room
short: Floor clear, surfaces clear, bed made, trash and dishes out.
proof: Before and after.

title: Clean Your Desk
short: Clear everything off your desk that doesn't belong there.
proof: Before and after of your desk.

title: Clear One Cluttered Surface
short: Clear one table, counter or dresser until only what belongs there is left.
proof: Before and after.

title: Organize One Drawer
short: Empty one drawer, throw out the junk and put back only what you use.
proof: Before and after of the drawer.

title: Organize Your Closet for 15 Minutes
short: Hang, fold and sort your closet for 15 minutes and pull out what you don't wear.
proof: Before and after.

title: Do Your Laundry
short: Wash, dry and fold one load of your own laundry.
proof: The folded load.

title: Put Away Your Laundry
short: Fold and put away all of your clean laundry.
proof: Your empty laundry basket.

title: Do the Dishes
short: Wash, dry and put away the dishes.
proof: The empty sink.

title: Take Out Your Trash
short: Empty your trash and recycling and take them out.
proof: The empty bin.

title: Clean Out Your Backpack or Work Bag
short: Empty your bag, throw out the trash and pack back only what you need.
proof: Before and after, cards turned over.

title: Lay Out Your Clothes for Tomorrow
short: Pick and lay out tomorrow's clothes tonight.
proof: Your clothes, laid out.

title: Pack Your Bag for Tomorrow
short: Pack everything you need for tomorrow and put your bag by the door.
proof: Your packed bag.

title: Clean Up Your Computer Desktop
short: Delete, file or move everything on your computer desktop.
proof: Before and after of the screen.

title: Delete 20 Unnecessary Files
short: Delete or file 20 things in your downloads, desktop or drive on a computer.
proof: Before and after of the folder.

title: Organize Your Notes
short: Put your notes in one place, sorted by subject or project.
proof: Before and after.

title: Clean Your Car
short: Clear out the trash, wipe it down and vacuum the inside.
proof: Before and after of the inside.

title: Clean the Bathroom
short: Clean the sink, toilet, shower and floor, and never mix cleaning products.
proof: Before and after of the sink, shot from above.

title: Put Your Week Into a Calendar
short: Add every class, shift, practice and deadline for the next 7 days to one calendar.
proof: Your calendar on paper or a computer, private details covered.

title: Fix One Broken Thing
short: Repair one thing you own: sew a button, patch a tire, tighten a loose handle.
proof: Before and after of the item.

title: Clean the Kitchen
short: Wipe the counters, stove and sink, and throw out old food from the fridge.
proof: Before and after of the counter and sink.

title: Declutter for 30 Minutes
short: Pick one area and get rid of what you don't use for 30 minutes.
proof: Before and after.

title: Clean Up Your Email Inbox
short: Unsubscribe from what you never read and archive what you have dealt with.
proof: A note of how many lists you left and emails you archived.
